theorems.statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ) (W : ℕ → Rn n → Rn ℓ) (V : Rn n → (Rn n →L[ℝ] Rn ℓ)) (R : ℕ → ℝ), Tendsto R atTop atTop → (∀ k, ContDiffOn ℝ 1 (W k) (ball (0 : Rn n) (R k))) → (∀ k, W k 0 = 0) → Continuous V → (∀ r : ℝ, TendstoUniformlyOn (fun k => fderiv ℝ (W k)) V atTop (closedBall (0 : Rn n) r)) → ∃ W' : Rn n → Rn ℓ, ContDiff ℝ 1 W' ∧ ∀ z, fderiv ℝ W' z = V z
